verdict.rationale: Google Cloud publishes official MCP servers. These are a documented Cloud Run MCP server, with a reference page and an official GoogleCloudPlatform repo, and the googleapis MCP Toolbox for Databases, which explicitly connects Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients to databases. missing for 10: in-depth setup/auth documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting, evidence of MCP coverage beyond Cloud Run and databases.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: An MCP server which operates on Cloud Run resources.
MCP server to deploy apps to Cloud Run
Instantly connect Gemini CLI, Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, or other MCP clients to your databases using our *prebuilt generic tools*.
MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects your AI agents, IDEs, and applications directly to your enterprise databases.
